projectAiResearch.visibilityDescription: Find brand mentions, cited pages and related questions in the provider's ChatGPT or Google AI Overview dataset. Dataset coverage depends on platform and market.
projectAiResearch.promptDescription: Compare the same prompt in two supported models. These synthetic tests show generated answers, mentions and returned citations. They do not measure real ChatGPT traffic or Google AI Overview visibility.
projectAiResearch.modelHint: GPT-4.1 mini + GPT-4.1 nano · Up to 512 output tokens per model · Web search disabled
projectAiResearch.validation: Check the brand, domain, prompt and maximum cost values.
projectAiResearch.cacheHint: Uses your connected provider. Cached results remain available for 12 hours.
projectAiResearch.requestFailure: Analysis could not be completed. Check your provider connection and review usage before trying again.
projectAiResearch.conservativeBound: Conservative admission bound: {cost} cents. This reserves the full documented model context plus bounded output because provider input overhead is unknown. Actual usage is recorded from the provider receipt.
projectAiResearch.visibilityEstimate: Estimated provider cost: {cost} cents. Your cost cap is checked before a new provider request.
projectAiResearch.emptyDescription: Estimate the cost, then run an analysis to save results to Agent Reports.
projectAiResearch.coverageDisclaimer: The provider returned no matches in this market. This does not establish that your brand is absent from every AI answer.
projectAiResearch.summary: {answers, number} answers · {mentions, number} brand mentions · {citations, number} domain citations
projectAiResearch.unknownCost: {cost} cents confirmed subtotal; total usage unknown
projectAiResearch.sample: Showing a bounded sample of {total, number} results. Counts describe the fetched answers only.
projectAiResearch.noCitations: No citations returned by this model.
projectAiResearch.partialFailure: The analysis could not be completed. Confirmed results are retained. Review provider usage before retrying.
projectAiResearch.contentTruncated: Answer excerpts are shortened to fit the saved report.
projectAiResearch.readOnly: This project is read-only or your role cannot run paid analyses. You can still open saved reports.
projectAiResearch.noSource: Connect a compatible data provider in Integrations.
